newsitem.title: FRANCE: France names G7 Cambodia envoy.
newsitem.headline: France names G7 Cambodia envoy.

text.p: France on Monday named Claude Martin, the Foreign Ministry's Deputy Secretary General, to travel on a G7 mission to Cambodia with a Japanese envoy.
A ministry spokesman said Martin and Yukio Imagawa, a former Japanese ambassador to Cambodia, would be in Phnom Penh on Wednesday.

Leaders of the Group of Seven leading industrial countries and Russia agreed in Denver last week to send the two envoys to to study the situation in Cambodia ahead of a scheduled visit there by U.S. Secretary of State Madeleine Albright.
